name: drupal/varbase_ai_search_base
description: Varbase AI Search: a vector index of the site's content with AI Search over the site's default vector database provider, the retrieval half of Ask AI. Experimental. Opt-in: never applied by default.

suggest.drupal/ai_vdb_provider_mariadb: The vectors in the site's own MariaDB 11.7+ database, no extra service. The only provider with a stable release.
suggest.drupal/ai_vdb_provider_milvus: The first supported vector backend (docs/decisions/0001). Needs a Milvus server outside Upsun.
suggest.drupal/ai_vdb_provider_sqlite: A vector database in one file through sqlite-vec, no service to run. What the pilot was verified with on DDEV.
